text:
QUOTE: `mbedtls_memory_buffer_alloc_init(buf, len)` (`memory_buffer_alloc.c:566-600`) calls `mbedtls_platform_set_calloc_free()` with its own `buffer_alloc_calloc` / `buffer_alloc_free`, or the `_mutexed` variants when `MBEDTLS_THREADING_C` is on.
VERDICT: MISS
WHY: The answer says the buffer allocator installs itself via the setter from its init function. It never says it is the only in-tree user, and it calls the setter "the same mechanism the library uses internally" without naming that exclusivity. It also doesn't name MBEDTLS_MEMORY_BUFFER_ALLOC_C.
